title: A Head Camera Is (Almost) All You Need: An Electronics-Free UMI Glove Labelled and Observed by One Moving Camera
abstract: arXiv:2610.27622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Handheld demonstration devices decouple data collection from the robot, but conventional designs burden the hand with a wrist camera, cables and a pose tracker (SLAM, an IMU, a VR controller, or a fixed external camera that the collector's body occludes), and burden the pipeline with as many data streams to timestamp, synchronise and cross-calibrate. We show that a single egocentric camera (USD 122) worn on the collector's head replaces the wrist camera, the pose tracker and their separate streams with one. It reads printed fiducials on an electronics-free glove (USD 22) against paper tiles taped around the workspace, giving the 6-DoF gripper pose and the jaw width from the same frames the policy will see; at deployment the same camera rides a low-cost (USD 120) arm beside the robot that mimics the collector's head from the robot's joint state. Against the robot's encoders the labels are accurate to 6.5 mm and 1.6 degrees median with 9

translated_title: 头戴相机（几乎）就够了：由单个移动相机标注与观测的无电子元件UMI手套
translated_abstract: 手持示教设备将数据采集与机器人解耦，但传统设计给手部带来负担：腕部相机、线缆以及位姿跟踪器（SLAM、IMU、VR控制器，或会被采集者身体遮挡的固定外部相机），同时给数据处理流水线带来众多需要打时间戳、同步和交叉标定的数据流。我们证明，一个佩戴在采集者头上的单个第一视角相机（122美元）即可取代腕部相机、位姿跟踪器及其各自分离的数据流，合而为一。它通过以粘贴在工作区周围的纸质标记板为参照，读取无电子元件手套（22美元）上印刷的基准标记，从策略模型将来所能看到的同一批画面帧中获得6自由度夹爪位姿和夹爪张口宽度；在部署阶段，同一个相机安装在机器人旁边一个低成本（120美元）的机械臂上，该机械臂根据机器人的关节状态模拟采集者的头部姿态。相对于机器人编码器，标注的中位数精度达到6.5毫米和1.6度
tldr: 本文提出仅用采集者头戴的一个相机，通过读取无电子元件手套上的印刷基准标记来同时完成腕部相机拍摄和6自由度位姿标注，大幅简化了机器人示教数据采集的硬件成本与多数据流同步的复杂性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a single head-worn camera reading printed fiducials on an electronics-free glove can replace the wrist camera and pose tracker, dramatically simplifying the hardware and data pipeline of robot demonstration collection.
